Tracked vendor partners

The Compare tool currently tracks 11 brands. Here's a plain description of what each one actually makes — this is general background, not a Remy-tested endorsement. For products he's actually tried, see Lab Notes.

Pack Leashes

Partner · 20% off

Colorado-based dog accessories brand making leashes, collars, harnesses, and bandanas in colorful, pattern-driven designs, often as matching sets. Leashes use rope-and-carabiner hardware.

Visit site

Brooks & Roo

Partner · 15% off

Arizona-based brand focused specifically on dog bandanas, made from soft cotton fabric in seasonal and themed prints. A portion of profits goes toward rescue-dog causes.

Visit site

Sniff & Bark

Partner · 20% off

Women-owned dog apparel and gear brand, originally founded in Vancouver and now based in Massachusetts. Makes bowtie collars, leashes, harnesses, rain vests, fleece coats, bandanas, and poop bag holders, with a portion of profits going to dog shelters.

Visit site

Mighty Paw

Direct link

Founded by Corey for his dog Barley, this brand covers walking gear (leashes, harnesses, collars) plus a line of natural chews, including the Yak Cheese chews Remy has already tried. Runs a buy-one-give-one chew donation program.

Visit site

SodaPup

Partner · 10% off

USA-made enrichment brand specializing in rubber and nylon chew toys, lick mats, and slow-feeder bowls, often in playful shapes (soda cans, holiday icons). Materials are FDA-compliant and built specifically for power chewers.

Visit site

Woof

Partner · 10% off

Denver-based brand focused on enrichment toys, dental care, and chews, built around their award-winning Pupsicle toy. Also makes the Bite n' Brush dental toy and HonestChew, a plant-based alternative to traditional bones.

Visit site

Rigby

Partner

A daily nutrition pouch made with organic whole-food ingredients (beef, chicken, salmon), designed to be squeezed onto meals, used in training, or spread in enrichment toys. A food format rather than gear.

Visit site

How this works: these descriptions are general background on each brand, not a Remy-tested endorsement. Pack Leashes, Brooks & Roo, Sniff & Bark, Woof, and SodaPup are paid partners with active discount codes. Rigby is also a paid partner, but doesn't currently offer a discount code. Mighty Paw is tracked for price comparison only, with a plain direct link and no commission.
